name: Generate images of fMRI overlaid on T1
summary: Generates a PNG of the first fMRI volume, brain-extracted with FSL bet, overlaid on a T1-weighted image with FSLeyes, to check fMRI-to-T1 registration.
description: Takes the first volume of the BOLD series (fslselectvols), brain-extracts it with FSL bet, and renders it (red-yellow) with its mask outline on the T1 with fsleyes render, writing raw/out.png. The fMRI and T1 must already be aligned. Use it to check functional-to-anatomical alignment.

inputs.description: fMRI (task) BOLD series; its first volume is rendered.
inputs.requirements: Must already be aligned to the T1.

inputs.description: T1-weighted image used as the background.

outputs.description: Directory with out.png showing the fMRI volume and its mask outline overlaid on the T1.
